description.value: The Cabins at Alert Bay is a 'N a mgis First Nation owned property on Cormorant Island offering 14 individual cabins, each with hardwood floors, electric fireplaces, fully equipped kitchens, and private verandas with BBQ access. Situated in one of BC's more remote and culturally rich coastal communities, it serves as a base for cultural experiences and eco-adventure in the Broughton Archipelago area. For a touring cyclist arriving by ferry, it offers a self-contained sanctuary with high-speed satellite internet and cable TV — a notable comfort on a remote island.
